line: Even the sun is new every day. Today has never happened before.
Good news: bouncing back is not rare. It is made of ordinary, everyday strengths.
So build them early: ready your sledge in summer, your cart in winter.
Ants know it too: small, not strong, yet they store food in summer.
At 15, Amundsen trained in the snow every free day, years before his adventures.
credit: Roald Amundsen · My Life as an Explorer

line: Strong, but not stiff: the willow bends under snow and does not break.
Then the mind: whatever comes, keep doing your work, steady and brave.
The Buddha's last words: everything changes, so keep practising with care.
credit: The Buddha · Digha Nikaya 16, tr. Sujato

line: Missed a day? In one study, one miss did not spoil the habit.
credit: Lally et al. · Eur J Soc Psychol, 2010

line: Morning Ashtanga is your summer sledge. Practise for years: peace is coming. No problem.
credit: Pattabhi Jois · recalled by Kino MacGregor
